According to Fig. 5 (g-h) in the text, 
- The charge transfer resistance ( Rct) for the bare NCM material increased from 27.99 to 224.04 Ω during 50 cycles.
- The charge transfer resistance ( Rct) for the LPO-coated NCM material increased from 14.88 to 144.75 Ω during 50 cycles.

The text does not mention the capacity retention after 100 cycles at 1C for the bare and the coated material.
